events.description: Chandler Bing says that fourteen and a half minutes have passed since Chandler Bing and Jill Goodacre began this interaction.
Chandler Bing says that Chandler Bing still has not said a single word to Jill Goodacre.
Chandler Bing says that Chandler Bing should do something, make contact with Jill Goodacre, and smile at Jill Goodacre.
Chandler Bing says that Chandler Bing is successfully smiling at Jill Goodacre.
Chandler Bing says that Chandler Bing is definitely scaring Jill Goodacre.
Jill Goodacre asks whether Chandler Bing would like to call somebody right now.
Chandler Bing says that Chandler Bing went to high school with about 300 guys.
